_doc: ⚑ S191 — THE RECOMMENDATION, 2003 (Phase 5; PLAN_ROUND5 'from early Internet Explorer to modern Chrome'). After his first daily check-in, a senior member of the programme's forum recommends a thread; the forum opens in the period's browser. Before the board, its RULES page — 'I Agree' the only live answer, the web twin of the rules sheet on the institution's wall. The thread is about coming home from the programme; he can post one fixed line (no free typing), a moderator approves it, and '3 people are praying for you'. GROUNDING (his research SocialMedia_Deep.md §2; intake.md): moderated, confidential forums with membership approval, category rooms by age/sex/marital status, accountability threads, peer prayer, senior members answering newcomers (Living Hope's boards, documented from 1998 — described in 2003 as a 'confidential, free, moderated message board'); the Rules page and 'I Agree' are the research's own proposal [I]. Every mark here is INVENTED (Harbor, WebView, the members).

rules.title: Before you enter
lines: Confidentiality — what is said here stays here.
No exchanging personal contact information.
Respect biblical teaching.
No sexually explicit material.
Accountability is an act of love.

_docS196: ⚑ S196 — the web, 2003 (PLAN_WEB_AND_HELPERS §2): Harbor becomes a place, not only a thread. Its index carries the recommendation (David's thread, pinned 'recommended for you'), the rooms, Resources, 'Find a group near you' and the conference. Every page speaks a documented position of the period in the seller's voice and names its dossier card at the foot: 'Healing is a process' → the person split from the identity, and a lapse framed as confession (e3_theday#4, #2); 'The wound behind it' → the father/mother 'wound' teaching (#5); 'For families' → families as a ministry of their own (#8); 'Find a group near you' → closed peer accountability groups (#0); the conference → the travelling parents' conferences (origin_intake_e1#1). Invented marks, no real people.

process.heading: Healing is a process
lines: You are not gay. You are a person who struggles
with same-sex attraction. The attraction is not you.
Healing is a process, not an event. A fall is not
the end: confess it, pray through it, tell your
accountability partner, and keep walking.

wound.heading: The wound behind it
lines: Behind most same-sex attraction is a wound:
a father who was absent, a mother too close,
a need for a man's love that was never met.
Name the wound. Let God meet the need
in safe, same-sex friendship.

families.heading: For families
lines: Your son's struggle is your family's too.
Families have a ministry of their own here:
a parents' group, a curriculum, a counsellor.
Grief is normal. Grace and truth, together.
Love him without condoning.

directory.heading: Find a group near you
lines: Weekly groups meet in 140 cities.
Membership is closed: what is shared stays in the room.
NORTHEAST · SOUTHEAST · MIDWEST · SOUTHWEST · WEST
Ask your group leader for an accountability partner.

conference.heading: Conference 2003
lines: One day. Twelve cities. For parents, pastors and youth.
Hear from people who walked out.
Workshops: 'Understanding your child', 'The early signs'.
Register your youth group — group rates for churches.
